title: Justice League #40 DC New 52 2015 1st Grail Darkseid Jason Fabok Cover Johns
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Justice League #40 (June 2015), DC Comics, The New 52 - the prologue to The Darkseid War, with the first appearance of Grail, Darkseid's daughter. Split Darkseid / Anti-Monitor cover by Jason Fabok. Written by Geoff Johns, with art by Kevin Maguire, Jim Lee, Scott Williams and others.

Back cover: Wrigley's 5 Ascent gum ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
